subject: afl
title: AFL.------POL.CON.
description: Second diagram on page 127 (ALT(FT)II-21), paired with ACT × INFO-TRNS above. Where the first diagram structurally shows the routes by which action and information-transition cross under the western-definers' apparatus, this one names what affinity-alignment meets when political-consideration is the working partner: AFL (affinity alignment — the form's actual affinity orientation) crossed with POL-CON (political consideration — the partner-axis's political-working that converts affinity-alignment into receivable form). AFL sits centrally with the subject-arrow; SOC-RT-DY (social-reality dynamics) rises above and INFO-FM (information form/medium) sits at upper-right with IST-F (isolated focus) and PART (participation) further right as the partner-side upper chain. POL-P (political particulars) sits centrally as the bridging hub with AGT (agent/agency) to its left and ATTN (attention) on the right margin. POL-CON sits at left as partner-axis. MOT-DY (motion dynamics) hangs at lower-left as the partner-axis downward output. RTD-PRD (rooted-period) sits centrally below as the bridging-axis downward hub with RT-INT-TR (reality-internal transformation) at the bottom as the bridging terminus. Structural argument: when affinity-alignment is crossed with political-consideration, the upper diagonal SOC-RT-DY → INFO-FM → IST-F / PART → ATTN is the *information-medium route* — social-reality dynamics routes through information-form and isolated-focus participation into attention, the partner-side's converted reception. AGT → POL-P is the bridging hub: agent/agency holds the political-particulars hub through which the form's affinity-alignment reaches the partner-axis. POL-CON → MOT-DY is what political-consideration produces alone — motion-dynamics, the partner's downward terminus. AFL → RTD-PRD → RT-INT-TR is the bridging downward chain — affinity-alignment routes through rooted-period into reality-internal transformation. The structural argument: combat-the-mis-information (from the section's closing prose) requires holding the AGT → POL-P bridging hub open *and* the RTD-PRD diagonal back into RT-INT-TR — without both, the upper diagonal's attention-output absorbs affinity-alignment into the partner-axis's information-form while the political-consideration produces only motion-dynamics on its own side.
